# review-annotations

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-001 — The review comments file next to a document holds its threads as data](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-001.md) — When a document is shown, the extension SHALL look for its review threads in a file with the name of the document, its extension replaced by .comments.json, in the same folder, read them as plain data with only the fields of the format, and write them back in one stable form.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-002 — Comment thread text stays readable on every theme](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-002.md) — When a review comment thread is shown in the preview in the Dark, White or Cream theme mode, the extension SHALL draw its author, date, text, placeholder and button text with a contrast of at least 4.5 to 1 on their surface, without dimming text through opacity.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-003 — Edit mode titles an open comment with its literal tag](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-003.md) — While edit mode is on, when the writer opens an HTML comment chip, the preview SHALL title the opened block with the literal opening syntax of the comment, <!-- --> for a comment and <!-- TODO --> for a comment whose text starts with TODO in any case, and the renderer SHALL treat that comment as a TODO comment.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-004 — A review comments file with any problem or over its limits is ignored with one warning](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-004.md) — When any part of the review comments file of a shown document is not valid or goes over one of its limits, the extension SHALL read no thread from it, show one warning naming the file and the first problem once for each distinct content of the file, and refuse every change to it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-005 — The word diff reports the added and removed words](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-005.md) — When the extension compares the text of a block at the last commit with its text now, it SHALL report the character ranges of the old text that are not in the new text and the character ranges of the new text that are not in the old text, comparing word by word, merging consecutive changed words into one range, and marking all words of both texts when the comparison would exceed 4 000 000 word pairs.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-006 — The host posts the baseline rendering while the side-by-side diff is on](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-006.md) — While the side-by-side diff is on for a tracked file in a trusted workspace and markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.showIncomingChanges is not false, the host SHALL post to the page the text at the last commit rendered like the page content with its blocks numbered by the lines of that text, together with the line hunks between that text and the shown text, again when the shown text or the commit changes, and SHALL post an empty baseline when the file is not known to Git or the text at the last commit cannot be rendered.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-007 — The side-by-side messages are validated and gated](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-007.md) — When the page reports the side-by-side diff switch or the host posts a baseline, the protocol SHALL accept the page message only with a boolean on field for the current render, accept the host message only with an html string of at most 20 MiB and at most 100 000 hunks of non-negative integer lines whose ends are not more than one before their starts, and drop any other message.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-008 — The Side-by-side button switches the diff and is disabled in edit mode](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-008.md) — When the reader presses the Side-by-side button of toolbar row 3, the page SHALL toggle the side-by-side diff, set the button pressed state and label to match, post the new state to the host, and, while edit mode is on, disable the button, show no diff and leave the green change bars as they are.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-009 — A changed block shows as a side-by-side diff](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-009.md) — While the side-by-side diff is on and a baseline for the current render is held, the page SHALL replace each block that changed since the last commit by a card with the rendered block at the last commit on the left and the rendered current block on the right, mark the removed words on the left and the added words on the right, leave the left empty for an added block and show a removed block with an empty right side, leave unchanged blocks as they are, and show the original blocks again when the diff goes off or the baseline is stale.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-010 — The line diff reports hunks with both sides](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-010.md) — When the extension compares a base text with the current text for the side-by-side diff, it SHALL report each difference as a hunk that gives the base lines and the current lines it covers as 1-based inclusive ranges, with an empty side (end one before start) for lines only added or only removed, ignore differences of line endings, and report the whole differing middle as one hunk when more than 20 000 lines differ or more than 2000 edits are needed.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-012 — The host posts the threads of the review comments file and follows its changes](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-012.md) — When a document is shown or its review comments file is created, changed, deleted or written by the Studio, the extension SHALL post the current threads of the file to the page with their comments, anchors, resolved flags and orphaned verdicts, once for each distinct content, never from a read that a newer read overtook and never from a read that failed.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-017 — The quote of a thread is highlighted once in its block](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-017.md) — When review threads are applied to the page, the extension SHALL wrap the first occurrence of each thread quote, found inside one text node of the innermost mapped block that covers the anchor line, in one highlight, or add a badge to that block when the quote is not found inside one text node, and never mark code, math, diagrams, the properties table, open editors or included content.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-021 — A highlight, badge or orphan entry opens the thread popover](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-021.md) — When a reader clicks, or presses Enter or Space on, a thread highlight, a thread badge or an orphaned comments entry while comments are shown, the extension SHALL toggle the popover of that thread, which lists every comment as plain text and stays inside the pane.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-028 — Threads that cannot be placed are listed in the Orphaned comments box](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-028.md) — When the page cannot place a review thread, the extension SHALL list it as an entry of an Orphaned comments region placed after the content.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-038 — Selected body text offers a Comment button and a keyboard shortcut](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-038.md) — When a reader selects text inside mapped body blocks of a writable preview, the page SHALL show a Comment button near the selection, and open the comment box for that selection on Cmd+Alt+M (macOS) or Ctrl+Alt+M (elsewhere).
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-044 — The comment box sends a comment and keeps its text until the host accepts it](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-044.md) — When a reader writes a comment in the comment box, the page SHALL send the typed text to the host only on Save, Cmd+Enter or Ctrl+Enter with a text that is not blank, and keep the box and its text open until the host answers that the comment is saved.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-049 — A new comment is anchored by its lines, quote and surroundings](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-049.md) — When a reader saves a comment on a selection, the page SHALL anchor it from the first line of the first selected block to the last line of the last selected block, with the selected text collapsed and cut at 500 characters and up to 32 characters of text before and after it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-054 — The host writes comment changes one after another within the file limits](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-054.md) — When the host receives a create message from a writable preview of a saved document, the extension SHALL append a thread with the anchor as sent, resolved false and one comment, with thread and comment ids and the time chosen by the host, in the review comments file next to the document, running the changes of one file one after another on its latest content and refusing with a reason and a warning, and writing nothing, a change that the file state or its limits do not allow, and writing through a temporary file renamed onto the comments file and never into a comments file that is a symbolic link.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-065 — A comment carries the configured, Git or system author name](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-065.md) — When the host stores a comment or a reply, the extension SHALL use as author the comments.authorName setting, else the Git user.name of the document repository, else the operating system user name, else Anonymous, with control characters replaced by spaces and the name trimmed and cut at 100 characters.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-069 — A comment create message needs a valid anchor and a bounded body](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-069.md) — When a previewCommentCreate message reaches the host, the extension SHALL drop it without an answer unless its anchor has integer lines with 1 <= line <= endLine, a quote of at most 500 characters and a prefix and suffix of at most 32 characters, and its body has 1 to 10 000 characters.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-070 — A comment reply message names a thread and carries a bounded body](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-070.md) — When a previewCommentReply message reaches the host, the extension SHALL drop it without an answer unless it has a non-empty thread id and a body of 1 to 10 000 characters.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-071 — Resolve and delete messages name a thread; resolve carries a flag](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-071.md) — When a previewCommentResolve or previewCommentDelete message reaches the host, the extension SHALL drop it without an answer unless it has a non-empty thread id and, for resolve, a boolean resolved flag.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-073 — Comment messages are accepted for any revision of the document](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-073.md) — When a comment message names the shown document and render, the extension SHALL handle it whatever revision of the document it names.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-074 — Reply, resolve, reopen and delete change the named thread only](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-074.md) — When the host handles a reply, resolve or delete message for a thread of the review comments file, the extension SHALL append the comment, set the resolved flag or remove the thread of that name only and change no other thread, and refuse with a reason and write nothing when that thread does not exist or already holds 200 comments.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-081 — The thread popover of a writable preview sends a reply and keeps it until accepted](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-081.md) — When the popover of a review thread opens in a writable preview, the extension SHALL show a reply text area labelled "Reply to this thread" and a Reply button.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-086 — Resolve, Reopen and a confirmed Delete wait for the host, one action at a time](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-086.md) — When a reader presses Resolve or Reopen in a thread popover, the extension SHALL send the new flag to the host, wait for its answer, and change the highlight only when the thread is posted again.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-094 — Edits move the stored lines of a thread in memory](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-094.md) — When lines are inserted or removed above a review thread in an edited document, the extension SHALL move the stored lines of the thread by the same number of lines in memory.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-100 — A thread follows its quote in the plain text, narrowed by its context](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-100.md) — When the quote of a review thread is no longer in its old lines but occurs in the document at one place, the extension SHALL move the thread to the lines of that place.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-101 — A thread whose quote is gone or ambiguous is orphaned and keeps its lines](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-101.md) — When the quote of a review thread cannot be found and its old lines do not resemble it, the extension SHALL mark the thread as orphaned and keep its stored lines and comments.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-107 — A slightly changed quote is followed by a bounded fuzzy search](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-107.md) — When a review thread quote has no exact copy, the extension SHALL move the thread to the one place of the document that differs from the quote by at most 20 percent of its length and agrees on numbers and negation words, searching only around the rarest word of the quote within a fixed cost bound, and orphan the thread when there is no such place or the places are ambiguous.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-119 — Moved thread lines are written with the document save only](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-119.md) — When the document is saved, the extension SHALL write the moved lines of the review threads to the comments file through the same write queue, and write that file only then and only when it exists, is valid and has no unsaved changes in an editor.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-125 — A renamed document takes its review comments file along](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-125.md) — When a document is renamed or moved, the extension SHALL rename its comments file to the new name and set the document name inside it, and leave every comments file where it is, never overwriting one, when the move is not safe.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-133 — HTML comments show as gray chips carried as data](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-133.md) — When a document holds an HTML comment that is not a tool comment, the renderer SHALL write a gray chip labelled comment at the place of the comment, with the comment text kept as a text node in a hidden body and never written as HTML.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-139 — TODO words and TODO comments show as green chips](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-139.md) — When a paragraph holds the word TODO not glued to letters, digits or an underscore, or an HTML comment starts with that word in any case (with or without a colon, on one or several lines), the renderer SHALL replace the word by a green TODO chip titled TODO and leave the rest of the sentence unchanged, and leave the word TODO plain in inline code, a fenced code block, link text, a URL and math.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-143 — A click or Enter on a chip toggles its comment box](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-143.md) — When a reader clicks a comment chip, or presses Enter or Space on a focused one, the page SHALL toggle the box that shows the comment text under the line, with the title and shape of its comment kind, and keep which boxes are open for the panel.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-152 — The showComments setting and the Comments button hide and show every review mark](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-152.md) — When the setting markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.showComments is read, the extension SHALL treat the value false as off and every other value, including no value, as on, and while the setting is off or the Comments button is off it SHALL hide the gray and the thread chips and every review mark of the preview (highlight colour and underline, badges, the Orphaned comments box), keeping the quoted text as plain text that opens no thread popover and is not in the Tab order.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-156 — A show-comments message of another render is ignored](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-156.md) — When a previewShowComments message names another document, revision or request than the page's, the extension SHALL not change the show-comments state.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-160 — The TODO action wraps or unwraps the touched lines in TODO comments](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-160.md) — When a writer runs the TODO action in a block editor on lines that are not wrapped, the page SHALL wrap each non-blank line touched by the caret or the selection in a TODO comment, after its indentation, and unwrap them when every non-blank touched line is already wrapped.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-167 — An inline THREAD comment shows as a thread chip with its messages](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-167.md) — When a document holds a `<!-- THREAD` comment as its own block, the renderer SHALL write a green chip with a speech bubble, labelled with the author of the first message and, with several messages, followed by their number in parentheses, whose box lists each message with its author, date and text, and write any other THREAD comment as an ordinary comment chip.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-171 — An open inline thread offers Reply and Delete thread](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-171.md) — When a writable preview shows an inline thread, the page SHALL add once to the body of the thread a reply text area labelled "Reply to this thread" with the placeholder Reply, a Reply button and a Delete thread button titled "Delete the whole thread from the document", and send a reply or a delete of the thread to the host with its source lines.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-178 — An inline thread change message carries valid lines and a non-blank text](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-178.md) — When a previewThreadReply or previewThreadDelete message reaches the host, the extension SHALL drop it unless it has an edit id, integer lines with 1 <= line <= endLine and, for a reply, a text of 1 to 10 000 characters that is not blank.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-186 — The host appends a reply inside the thread comment under the author](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-186.md) — When the host receives a reply to an inline thread, the extension SHALL, if the named lines are still exactly one thread comment and the document has not changed meanwhile, add one message, a header with the author on one line and the local date and time as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM and the reply text indented by two spaces, above the closing --> and change nothing else, and otherwise answer with the reason and leave the document unchanged.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-190 — An empty or too long reply is refused by the host](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-190.md) — When the host receives a reply that is blank or longer than 10 000 characters, or whose lines are not a thread, the extension SHALL answer "The reply could not be added to this thread." and change nothing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-192 — Deleting an inline thread removes whole lines](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-192.md) — When the host applies a delete of an inline thread, the extension SHALL remove the lines of the thread and one surrounding blank line when both neighbours are blank or missing, remove the line break before a thread that ends the file, and change nothing else.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-195 — The host posts the lines that differ from the last commit](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-195.md) — When the shown document is a file tracked by Git, in a trusted workspace, with preview.showIncomingChanges on and the Diff choice on, the extension SHALL post to the page the line ranges of the shown text, unsaved edits included, that differ from the file at HEAD, and in every other case post an empty list of ranges only to take back marks the page shows.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-200 — The line diff reports added and modified lines](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-200.md) — When the extension compares a base text with the current text, it SHALL report the added and modified lines of the current text as 1-based ranges, merging adjacent lines and keeping separate edits as separate ranges, report no range for a difference of line endings, of a missing final newline or of deleted lines only, and report the whole differing middle as one range when more than 20 000 lines differ or more than 2000 edits are needed.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-203 — The HEAD text comes from the built-in Git extension for small files](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-203.md) — When the extension needs the text of a file at HEAD, it SHALL read it through the built-in Git extension without starting a process, return nothing when Git cannot give it or when the shown text, the document or the HEAD text is not a file under 1 MiB, and announce a change of the Git state only when the HEAD commit id has changed.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-207 — Changed blocks get a thin change bar that moves nothing](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-207.md) — When the page receives line ranges, the extension SHALL mark the innermost mapped element whose lines meet a range with data-sphinx-preview-changed and draw, for each marked block, a green bar 3 px wide with square ends, as high as the box of the block, in one column at the left margin of the page, without moving any block or text edge.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-208 — Malformed incoming-change ranges are ignored](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-208.md) — When a range received by the page is not a pair of integers with 1 <= start <= end, the extension SHALL ignore it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-214 — The Diff button and the showIncomingChanges setting hide the change bars](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-214.md) — When the page applies the Diff state, the page SHALL set the Diff button to pressed with the label Hide changes since last commit while the marks are shown, and to not pressed with the label Show changes since last commit while they are hidden, hide or show the change bars at once and post the incomingChanges view preference when the reader presses it, and show no change marks and no Diff button when markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.showIncomingChanges is false.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-215 — Changed or added front matter fields get their own change bar](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-REVIEW-215.md) — When the page receives line ranges that meet the lines of a front matter field, the extension SHALL mark the properties table row of that field with data-sphinx-preview-changed and draw one change bar for that row, like the bar of a changed body block, and when a field present at HEAD is missing from the shown text and no row is marked, it SHALL mark the whole properties table.
